title: 雨天開店、長屋の古本屋
author: 藤堂 小太郎

en.title: Open Only When it Rains: The Tenement Bookstore
en.premise: Genji, a cheerful loudmouth living in the tenement houses of Fukagawa, discovers a mysterious secondhand bookstore that opens its doors only on rainy days. Within its pages, the old books hold the secret longings and forgotten memories of their former owners. Through these stories, Genji uses his meddlesome yet warm-hearted nature to unravel the loneliness and regrets of those living around him.

zh.title: 雨天開店，長屋的古書店
zh.premise: 住在深川長屋的樂天派源次，偶然發現了一家僅在雨天悄悄營業的神祕古書店。店內販售的古書中，綴寫著前任所有者深藏的心願與被遺忘的記憶。源次透過這些書籍，以他那熱心且愛管閒事的人情味，逐漸化解鄰居們心中深藏的孤獨與後悔。
